summary: Docs-site deploy job failing in CI due to quickstart template snippet extraction step
description:
Issue summary:
- Docs-site deploy job is failing on main due to the "extract-template-snippets" step.
- This blocks publishing the Quickstart templates landing pages + walkthroughs.

Impact:
- Internal: docs deploy blocked; PR queue piling up for quickstart-related docs updates.
- External: would have delayed the Quickstart templates launch if not fixed quickly.

Where it fails:
- Pipeline: docs-site (GitHub Actions) -> build -> snippet extraction -> mdx compile.
- Step name: extract-template-snippets

Error observed:
- extractor exits non-zero when encountering code blocks containing templating braces or non-standard fence markers.
- Additionally, a subset of snippet references point to moved files in redwood-quickstarts after the repo restructure.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Checkout redwood-docs at current main.
2) Run: pnpm run extract:snippets (or npm run extract:snippets depending on local setup).
3) Observe failure when processing quickstarts pages under /docs/quickstarts/*.

Notes / initial hypothesis:
- The new quickstart pages reference live snippets from redwood-quickstarts.
- The extractor assumes fenced blocks are strictly ```<lang> and does not tolerate braces like {{FOO}} within extracted regions.
- One of the referenced snippet paths includes "templates/rag/README.md" but repo moved to "templates/python/rag/README.md".

Requested outcome:
- Make extractor robust (don’t crash on braces; treat as plain text) and update snippet source paths to match redwood-quickstarts.
- Add a preflight validation step to catch missing snippet paths with a clear error message (file not found + suggested fix).
comments:
2026-01-29 10:12 (Wei Chen): Noticing docs deploy is red in #docs. Failure started after merging quickstart pages. Looks like snippet extraction is crashing on a code fence that includes handlebars-style braces (we use {{VAR}} in env var docs examples). Attaching log excerpt:

> Error: Snippet parse error at docs/quickstarts/rag.mdx: line 188
> Unexpected token "{" inside snippet region
> Exit code 1

Can someone from build/CI take a look? This is blocking ENG-2850 docs integration.

2026-01-29 11:03 (Sahana Iyer): Triage: confirmed reproducible on runner and locally. Two issues:
1) Parser treats any "{" inside extracted region as template syntax (legacy assumption from old docs tooling).
2) A couple snippet paths are stale after redwood-quickstarts repo reorg.

I can patch the extractor to treat braces as literal unless explicitly opted-in, and update the broken snippet references.

2026-01-29 13:20 (Elliot Price): +1 on treating braces as literal by default. We deliberately show env var placeholders like ${REDWOOD_API_KEY} and sometimes {{TENANT_ID}} in examples; extractor should not attempt template rendering. Also, if possible, can we make error messages point to the exact snippet directive and path?

2026-01-30 09:08 (Sahana Iyer): Fix in progress. Plan:
- Update extractor to run in "literal" mode for md/mdx sources (no template parsing).
- Improve error on missing path to include:
  - snippet directive location
  - resolved filesystem path
  - hint: run pnpm -w quickstarts:sync (or equivalent) to pull quickstarts repo.
- Update two broken paths for RAG template docs.

Will link PR once up.

2026-01-30 16:41 (Sahana Iyer): PR opened: https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood-docs/pull/889
Changes:
- extractor: disable brace interpolation; treat content as plain text.
- add path normalization + clearer "file not found" messaging.
- update snippet include paths for quickstart templates to match current redwood-quickstarts layout.

CI on PR is green. Requesting review from Docs (Elliot/Wei).
2026-01-31 10:02 (Wei Chen): Reviewed + approved. Confirmed the failing file now extracts successfully and mdx build completes. Also ran local build with the combined RAG+agent page—no issues.

2026-02-01 09:25 (Sahana Iyer): Merged PR 889. Docs deploy on main is green again. Closing ticket.

Follow-ups (non-blocking):
- Consider adding a small smoke test that runs snippet extraction against a representative set of quickstart pages (to catch path drift earlier).
- Align with redwood-quickstarts tooling from PR 379 to keep env var docs linting consistent.
resolution: Resolved by patching the docs snippet extractor to treat braces as literal content (no template parsing) and updating stale snippet source paths after the redwood-quickstarts repo restructure. Fix merged in redwood-docs PR #889; docs-site deploy job returned to green on main.
